# Mercury Call Desk

Mercury Call Desk (mercurycalldesk.com) sells AI phone agents and a full CRM
for local service businesses and agencies. AI voice assistants answer every
call 24/7, book appointments, and follow up by SMS. Includes a full outbound
dialer (10 lines per account), dispatch with technician tracking, and
Mercury CRM. No setup fees.

## Pricing

- Starter: $99/mo, 5 sub-accounts, unlimited users and contacts
- Professional: $299/mo, unlimited white-label sub-accounts, usage rebilling
  (mark up phone, SMS, email, AI for clients)
- Agencies: $399/mo limited-time, dispatch, AI agentic, SaaS resale rights
- Enterprise: custom quote, 4th column of the pricing table
- Annual billing: 2 months free. Usage billed at published per-minute/per-segment rates.
